## Running Code

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| error: false
#| warning: false
library (dplyr)
library(readr)
DonorHyperglycemia <- read_csv("DonorHyperglycemia.csv")
```


## Logistic Regression


```{r}
#| echo: false
DonorHyperglycemia$d_cod <- as.factor(DonorHyperglycemia$d_cod)

```




```{r}
m1 <- glm(delayed_fn ~ d_age + d_cod + d_caucasian + d_genderf + donorrisk, 
          data = DonorHyperglycemia,
          family = "binomial")

summary(m1)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(DonorHyperglycemia, aes(x = donorrisk, y = as.numeric(delayed_fn))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +  
  stat_smooth(method = "glm", 
              method.args = list(family = "binomial"), 
              se = TRUE) +   
  labs(title = "Effect of Donor Risk on Delayed Function",
       x = "Donor Risk Index",
       y = "Predicted Probability of Delayed Function")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(DonorHyperglycemia, aes(x = as.numeric(d_cod), y = as.numeric(delayed_fn != 1))) + 
  geom_jitter(height = 0.05, width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_smooth(method = "glm", 
              method.args = list(family = "binomial"), 
              se = TRUE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:4, labels = c("CVA" , "Head Trauma", "Anoxia" , "Other")) + 
  labs(title = "Effect of Donor Risk (d_cod) on Delayed Function",
       x = "Donor COD Level (1 = Reference)",
       y = "Predicted Probability of Delayed Function")
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(DonorHyperglycemia, aes(x = d_cod, y = as.numeric(delayed_fn) - 1)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5, height = 0.05, width = 0.2) +  
  stat_smooth(aes(group = 1), 
              method = "glm", 
              method.args = list(family = "binomial"), 
              se = TRUE) +   
  
  labs(title = "Effect of Donor Risk on Delayed Function",
       x = "Cause of Death",
       y = "Predicted Probability of Delayed Function")
```
